capabilities: Metadata graph, ownership, column lineage and discovery
limitation: Semantic context and lineage are not causal knowledge
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Catalog assets, ownership, schemas and lineage from bank systems.
scientific_qualification.output: Searchable metadata graph and context for candidate data mappings.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Metadata completeness and semantic correctness are separate from causal assumptions and actual feature availability.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Use the existing enterprise catalog where possible. The README mixes OSS and Cloud capabilities: only its explicit OSS metadata-graph/lineage/governance/discovery declaration is relied on here. Human context proposals need evidence-backed field semantics.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Import a bounded synthetic asset graph, preserve stable IDs and source-version links, and ensure lineage edges cannot be promoted automatically to causal arrows.

evidence.finding: Explicit DataHub OSS versus Cloud capability distinction.
